observed_evidence: 1/10 Tier 1 variants has exact-variant experimental support; 5/10 targets have gene-level perturbation data; 5/10 remain experimentally uncovered.
permitted_claim: Report coverage explicitly as one exact-variant, five gene-level and five uncovered candidates.
prohibited_claim: Do not state that all Top 10 variants were functionally validated.

observed_evidence: PDGFB has high L2G, macrophage specificity, exact cCRE/topic annotation and effective Perturb-seq knockdown, but no external UKB or MVP L2G support.
permitted_claim: Describe multimodal internal and public experimental support without external target-level replication.
prohibited_claim: Do not describe the PDGFB target as externally replicated.

observed_evidence: PRKCQ transcript knockdown is inconsistent; LPS IL-23 and IL-6/JAK/STAT3 pathway suppression is reproducible across guides.
permitted_claim: Report attenuated transcript evidence and LPS pathway-level functional support.
prohibited_claim: Do not call the transcript-level result strong target engagement.

observed_evidence: IL23R self log2FC is approximately +0.107 with FDR 0.85; the target transcript was not reduced.
permitted_claim: Classify the Perturb-seq result as inconclusive because editing was not verified.
prohibited_claim: Do not call IL23R experimentally negative or experimentally supported.

observed_evidence: Primary CAMK2A coloc H4 is 0.09; the maximum sensitivity H4 is approximately 0.33 and never reaches 0.80.
permitted_claim: Report no colocalization support and retain CAMK2A as a model-prioritized, non-positive candidate.
prohibited_claim: Do not describe CAMK2A as colocalized, replicated or causal.

observed_evidence: PRKCB and CHSY3 overexpression enrich inflammatory programs, but E2F, MYC, ribosome, translation and metabolic programs are also prominent.
permitted_claim: Report unadjusted enrichment with a growth and metabolic confounding caveat and growth-residualized sensitivity.
prohibited_claim: Do not interpret GSEA as variant-level causality or as evidence that growth effects are absent.

observed_evidence: JAK-STAT FDR is 0.037 and IL-6/JAK/STAT3 FDR is 0.037, but their 95% bootstrap intervals cross zero.
permitted_claim: Report FDR-supported one-sided bootstrap tails and disclose that the interval estimates are not strictly positive.
prohibited_claim: Do not describe either pathway as a strictly positive interval-confirmed effect.
